change_summary: Preserve independently changing source impacts before thematic grouping or destination choice, while keeping Runtime non-semantic.

canonical_skill.note: The Skill preserves independently changing impact boundaries in a weak handoff while leaving Project and carrier design to Corvio.

server_contract.note: The server asks the Agent to enumerate independently changing impacts before thematic grouping and destination choice while Runtime remains a typed transport and receipt owner.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together; compatibility family and minimum revision remain unchanged.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace and Admin CLI remain at 0.1.0-beta.35; their shared server-discovered processing-profile contract remains compatible and needs no CLI protocol change.

help_center.note: Public Help remains compatible because the public Skill page projects this shared package and the release does not change remote MCP connection or installation steps.

package_setup.note: SessionStart reports the new Skill release; the full Skill carries the weak impact-identity handoff boundary.

harness_and_mainline.note: The Harness adds impact identity before topic grouping and preserves the earlier source-completeness, owner, lifecycle and no-shape-quota boundaries.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party publication, public hashes and fresh released-host readback remain release gates; external directory acceptance stays outside repository authority.

release_evidence.note: Focused Prompt, Mission, RunOps and package gates cover independent impact identity, destination mapping and unchanged Runtime authority; the frontend source guard also keeps the desktop portal rule CSS-module-pure after webpack exposed the hidden Turbopack cancellation cause. Fresh released Codex trigger, transfer and countercase readback remain the outcome gate.
